basic_info.description: Located in a classic 1920s building in the heart of Russian Hill, Unit #2 is warm and inviting with a charming private entrance from the garden. This bright 2BD/1BA TIC offers approximately 782 square feet of thoughtfully preserved charm and modern amenities. All windows in this unit face onto beautiful gardens.  Inside, the home features hardwood floors, period molding, and a stunning original fireplace, adding timeless character to the living space. The kitchen is functional and well-equipped, and the washer/dryer provides everyday convenience.    Set within a secure, gated building with intercom entry and a peaceful garden walkway, residents also enjoy access to a shared rooftop deck with sweeping views of the city and Golden Gate Bridge ideal for relaxing or entertaining.    This home has parking available for an additional cost. With a stellar 97 Walk Score, you're just steps from Russian Hill's beloved cafes, shops, restaurants, cable cars, and MUNI bus routes. A Sirkin TIC agreement is in place, and HOA financials are professionally managed by Avenues HOA Financial Management.
